fields.statement: QA at e520ec719 with the built binary (go build -trimpath into the session scratchpad): in a scratch Rhiza root and repo, with fake rex, claude and gh on PATH and a clean env, ran rhiza run start --foreground <record cs> --workflow plan (it runs plan-milestone). Run status showed review visit 1 (one finding) -> has-findings pass -> critic -> fresh -> check fail -> revise -> review visit 2 (clean {"findings":[]}) -> has-findings fail (exit 3: latest review round holds no finding, so it needs no critic) -> fresh -> check pass -> gate, with no critic visit 2, and prompts.log held exactly one critic prompt. Inside the live run, the fake reviewer ran rhiza run review-check --findings after each round: exit 0 after the round with a finding, exit 3 after the clean round. rhiza run verdict with {"verdicts":[]} on the clean round exited 2 ('at least one'). rhiza workflow describe plan and plan-milestone both show review on.pass -> has-findings. The run then failed at open-pr only because the hand-run fake gh lacks pr edit, which is outside this change.
